critical_code_review_comments: validateB2G project-reference regex ^[123]\|.+ correctly enforces the myDATA/B2G BT-11 prefix '1|', '2|', '3|' — good.
buildPeppolInvoiceXml uses hardcoded GREEK_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT 9933:997001671 with proper schemeID/value split — matches KE.D./GSIS spec.
b2gReferences correctly falls back invoice→customer, so per-invoice overrides work — good design.
Send button relies on component prop `blocked` for `disabled` state — server action also re-validates in sendB2G (throws with errors.join(' ')), so it is defense-in-depth. Good.

providerSend for provider=simulation is fully offline (returns SIM-<Date.now()>) — no accidental external calls. providerStatus simulation transitions pending→sent→accepted deterministically as expected.

Nit: b2g-settings-form.tsx calls toast.error/success inside the render body (`if (state && !state.ok) toast.error(state.error)`) rather than inside useEffect. This can fire duplicate toasts on re-renders. Non-blocking, but recommend moving into useEffect keyed on `state`.
